blocks.text: Al-Haleem The Forbearing occurs repeatedly in the Noble Qur'aan in many places.
Truly, He is Ever Most Forbearing, Oft-Forgiving.
And Allah is Ever All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

Al-Haleem means the One who does not hasten the punishment for His servants due to their sins and disobedience. He sees His servants when they disbelieve and disobey whilst He is Forbearing with them, delays, looks and postpones rather than hastens. He grants them blessings despite their disobedience, many sins and slips. He forbears in dealing with the disobedient with their disobedience, He gives them respite in order for them to repent. He does not hasten in punishing them so that they can turn back and repent to Him.

Allaah informs us about His forbearance with the people of disobedience, sins and types of oppression that if He were to punish them for their sins one by one there would not remain an animal upon the surface of the earth.

And if Allah were to seize mankind for their wrong-doing, He would not leave on it (the earth) a single moving (living) creature, but He postpones them for an appointed term and when their term comes, neither can they delay nor can they advance it an hour (or a moment).

And your Lord is Most Forgiving, Owner of Mercy. Were He to call them to account for what they have earned, then surely, He would have hastened their punishment. But they have their appointed time, beyond which they will find no escape.

Despite them committing shirk - associating partners with Allaah, showing annoyance, striving to go against, fighting His Religion and showing enmity towards His allies, Allaah shows forbearance with them. He gives them many types of good, grants them provision and grants them well-being. As in the Saheehayn from the hadeeth of Abee Moosaa al Ash'aree who said, The Prophet ﷺ said:
"None is more patient than Allah against harmful sayings. He hears from the people that they ascribe children to Him, yet He gives them health and (supplies them with) provision."
From His forbearance over the owners of the ditch,

Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance, will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.
Hasan al-Basree said, "Look at this honour and generosity. They killed Allaah's allies and He calls them to repentance (tawbah) and forgiveness."

keyPoints: Al-Haleem occurs repeatedly in the Noble Qur'aan in many places.
Al-Haleem means the One who does not hasten the punishment for His servants due to their sins and disobedience; He delays and postpones, giving them respite so they can repent.
He grants them blessings despite their disobedience, many sins and slips.
If Allaah were to punish people for their sins one by one, not an animal would remain upon the surface of the earth.
Even with those who commit shirk and show enmity to His allies, He gives them provision and well-being, and He called the owners of the ditch to repentance.

evidence.text: And if Allah were to seize mankind for their wrong-doing, He would not leave on it (the earth) a single moving (living) creature, but He postpones them for an appointed term...
"None is more patient than Allah against harmful sayings. He hears from the people that they ascribe children to Him, yet He gives them health and (supplies them with) provision."

recall.a: The Forbearing: the One who does not hasten the punishment for His servants due to their sins and disobedience; He delays and postpones and gives them respite in order for them to repent.

recall.q: What would happen if Allaah punished people for their sins one by one?
recall.a: There would not remain an animal upon the surface of the earth (Nahl 16:61).

recall.q: Which hadeeth does the author cite about Allaah's forbearance with those who ascribe children to Him?
recall.a: The hadeeth of Abu Moosaa al-Ash'aree: "None is more patient than Allah against harmful sayings. He hears from the people that they ascribe children to Him, yet He gives them health and (supplies them with) provision."

recall.q: What did Hasan al-Basree say about the owners of the ditch?
recall.a: "Look at this honour and generosity. They killed Allaah's allies and He calls them to repentance (tawbah) and forgiveness."
